title: Episode
description: One published video: five dilemmas, their voiceover lines, and the metadata that ships with it. This file plus dna/video-dna.json is everything the render needs.

episode.description: Episode number. Appears in the badge and in the title — the numbered series is what makes viewers come back.

edition.description: Optional title tag, e.g. 'FOOD EDITION', 'HARD EDITION'. Measured to carry breakout videos at every channel size.

blocks.description: Exactly five, in ramp order: easy+funny, easy, medium, hard, hardest. The DNA's 8500ms block length assumes five.

stem.description: Spoken, never rendered. The screen shows only the two fragments.

image_a.description: Cut-out subject for the top field.

image_b.description: Cut-out subject for the bottom field.

reveal.description: How this block ends. Either real poll numbers, or an explicit prediction with no number. There is no third option.

source.description: Where the numbers came from. community_poll needs the Community tab, which YouTube gates at 500 subscribers; comment_poll counts A/B replies on the previous episode; authored means written by us rather than measured — the channel owner's decision, and named explicitly so a file never quietly passes off an invented figure as a counted one; prediction_no_number carries no figure at all.

vo.description: Timings of the spoken question, written back by make_voiceover.py. The line is synthesised in three segments — the stem, option A, and 'or' plus option B — so the moment each fragment is named is known exactly rather than estimated. Each caption and its image appear on that moment.

spoken.description: The full sentence as spoken, assembled from the three segments. Recorded for reference; the segments are what is synthesised.

setup.description: Deprecated. The line is now assembled from stem, option_a and option_b, so a hand-written sentence here could disagree with what is actually said.

setup_duration.description: Deprecated, superseded by the three segment durations.

reaction.description: Deprecated. The reveal carries no voiceover.

cta.description: The word on screen. One word, large — 'COMMENT'.

vo.description: Spoken over the end card while the tick runs underneath.

vo_duration.description: Measured length of the rendered end-card clip, written back by make_voiceover.py. The tick runs one second past it, then the chime closes the video.

title.description: Pattern: 'Would You Rather... #N' plus the edition when there is one. The numbered series is the measured winner in this niche.

tags.description: From the measured tag cloud: would you rather, quiz, would you rather game, this or that, wyr, impossible choices.

pinned_comment.description: Carries the poll link and the question that converts viewers into commenters.

video_id.description: Filled after upload; used to pull retention in the measure stage.

hashtags_in_title.description: Measured: titles carrying real hashtags underperform in this niche. Kept as an explicit field so the decision is recorded per episode rather than forgotten.

settings.description: The YouTube upload settings this episode ships with, so a re-upload or a second channel reproduces them exactly instead of relying on whatever the studio remembered.

made_for_kids.description: Must be false. Made-for-kids disables comments, and comments are this format's engine.

dna_version.description: The video-dna.json version this episode was rendered against, so a style change can be correlated with a retention change.
